annotations.title: Check an x402 conditional offer before signing

description: Run before signing a 402 that carries the ifso-conditional extension. Recomputes the payment address from the terms against IFSO's own v2.1 factory and refuses: an untrusted factory, a terms hash mismatch, a payTo that is not the terms' address, an amount or asset mismatch, a sender that is not the payer, a refund address that is not the payer, expired terms, a closed window or a window without a referee. Optionally checks the signed EIP-3009 authorization (to, value, from). Read only.

maxAmount.description: Most you will pay, in USDG base units (6 decimals).

payload.description: Optional: {authorization:{from,to,value}} of the EIP-3009 transfer you signed.
